alt: L.A. Care Health Plan profile on L.A. County Behavioral Health registry
summary: A screenshot of the Los Angeles County Behavioral Health registry (Network of Care) on August 15, 2026, displaying L.A. Care Health Plan's health insurance and dental coverage listing. The profile directs low-income members and clinical providers to the historical 1055 W. 7th St., 10th Fl. office address.
